# Interactive library regression corpus

`math-cards.html` preserves the structure and initialization calls of the page regression in #1966, with version and CSS import variations. `three-orbit.html` preserves the import-map and OrbitControls pattern in the shipped 3D generation template. `chart-tailwind.html` is a representative generated-page fixture covering runtime styling, charts, unknown resources, and a script containing HTML as data.

The fixtures are small hand-written pages that exercise the URL forms the mapper handles: pinned, ranged, unversioned and `latest` versions, CSS imports, ESM imports and import maps.
